column1: # Commands of the extension package "media-hub" (docs/PLAN-extensions.md). Same columns as scripts/lib/registry.tsv:

column5: the media apps found through the integration media (package, address, key, kind)
column6: die Medien-Apps, die über die Integration media gefunden wurden (Paket, Adresse, Schlüssel, Art)

column5: watch statistics from the monthly rollups: this month and all time
column6: Statistik aus den Monatssummen: dieser Monat und insgesamt

column5: count a finished playback: hs ext media-hub record-session <user> <minutes> [<title>]
column6: eine beendete Wiedergabe zählen: hs ext media-hub record-session <Nutzer> <Minuten> [<Titel>]

column5: note an import or an upgrade in the event log: hs ext media-hub record-import imported|upgraded <title> [<app>]
column6: einen Import oder ein Upgrade im Ereignisprotokoll vermerken: hs ext media-hub record-import imported|upgraded <Titel> [<App>]

column5: media apps as package, address, key (ok|locked|missing|-), kind; - = empty
one row: plays this month, minutes this month, plays in all, minutes in all, media apps found
one row per month, oldest first, the last 24: month, minutes, plays (all users added)
